mechanism_narrative: The current employment level (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism predicts positive returns based on the current employment level exceeding 150,000 thousand persons, a historical threshold for positive returns.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of all time periods, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 315) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a monetary policy tightening cycle that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 315 AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions (defined by GDP growth rate above 2.0% and industrial production above 105), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to overvaluation and rising interest rate risks.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when the late-cycle expansion condition is met, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates an economic slowdown that is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates policy easing.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low housing starts (HOUST < 1300) and low retail sales (RSAFS < 700000) indicates a weakening consumer demand that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300 AND RSAFS < 700000, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) and elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicates a monetary policy tightening cycle that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The mechanism is falsified if the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% AND FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or if the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
